setup.text: The jars line the cleared shelf, roughly half filled as the frost draws nearer. Mara checks a jar's seal against the light before setting it back down. "This one won't keep past the week without help."

option_a.text: The player hands over a measure of salt. Mara works it into the jar's seal, checks it again, and nods.

option_b.text: The player casts *preserve* on the herbs. The wilting stems stiffen at once, their green color deepening as the decay halts mid-motion. Mara glances at the batch without lifting her head. "That'll stay green through the thaw, that will."

option_c.text: The player asks, "Which ones are close?" Mara points toward two jars at the shelf's edge and says nothing further.
